levels.name: Sharp
levels.tagline: searches in a checkerboard, follows the hull

help.goal: Sink all five of the other player's ships before they sink yours.
steps: You start with an empty sea and five ships in the tray: Carrier 5, Battleship 4, Cruiser 3, Submarine 3, Destroyer 2.
Drag a ship from the tray onto the sea to place it, or tap the ship and then tap the square its bow should sit on.
↻ Rotate turns the ship in hand; tapping a ship already on the water turns it too. Drag a placed ship to move it.
Green means it fits there, red means it does not. ⚓ Ready lights up once all five are on the water.
On your turn tap any square on the target sea to fire there.
💥 is a hit, • is a miss, 🚢 is a sunk ship.
The screen shows the sea that matters: the target on your turn, your own while the other player aims. The 🎯 / 🛡 switch peeks at the other one.
notes: In a hurry? "place the rest for me" drops whatever is still in the tray at random.
Once you tap ⚓ Ready your fleet is locked in for the game.
A hit does not earn you another shot. Turns alternate after every single shot.
House rule: ships are allowed to touch, so there is no gap between hulls.
